name: Hypselorhachis
isnote: Possibly a ctenosauriscid; known from a single vertebra, so its position is uncertain (English Wikipedia).
sum: Hypselorhachis is a possible ctenosauriscid archosaur known only from a single tall-spined vertebra from the Middle Triassic Manda Beds of Tanzania.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A single vertebra from the Manda Beds, Tanzania.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Charig 1967
